maria: Quick heads-up — I'm converting nova-13b FP32 -> bf16 safetensors for the Private deploy. Putting artifacts in gs://redwood-models/onboard/nova-13b/conv-2026-02. Need eyes on TP sharding layout and tokenizer special token offsets before I request canary.

jamal: Thanks. What TP layout are you targeting? Our serving tooling expects TP=8 with interleaved shards named tp-0..tp-7. Was the original checkpoint TP=2/4?

ryan: The raw export looks like tensor-parallel chunks, but filenames are part_0.safetensors ... part_7.safetensors (no tp index). Also model_config.json shows "tie_word_embeddings": false — could shift word-piece ids vs our default tokenizer mapping.

maria: Conversion command I'm using (local test):
```
python tools/convert_checkpoint.py \
  --src /mnt/weights/nova-13b-fp32 \
  --dst gs://redwood-models/onboard/nova-13b/conv-2026-02 \
  --dtype bf16 \
  --shard-scheme tp-interleaved \
  --tp-size 8 \
  --emit-safetensors \
  --write-metadata
```
Will attach logs after run.

sasha: One gotcha I hit before: HF tokenizer.json for this family uses byte-level merges and has special tokens appended which cause a +3 id shift vs our standard cc tokenizer. If you serve without aligning special ids, prompts get tokenized incorrectly (odd <|pad|> placements).

sasha: Quick fix: run this to normalize special tokens before packaging:
```
python - <<'PY'
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
# ensure special tokens exist in canonical order
for tok in ['<pad>','<bos>','<eos>','<unk>']:
    if tok not in t.get_vocab():
        t.add_special_tokens([tok])
 t.save('tokenizer.normalized.json')
PY
```

jamal: I added a validation step to our pipeline: scripts/check_checkpoint.sh. It checks shard ordering, sizes, and a simple kv-cache dry-run. Example usage: `sh scripts/check_checkpoint.sh gs://redwood-models/onboard/nova-13b/conv-2026-02` — returns non-zero on mismatch.

build-bot: convert-nova-13b #4324 started by maria — upload in progress. artifacts: gs://redwood-models/onboard/nova-13b/conv-2026-02/parts/*.safetensors

qa-bot: Sanity test report: 1 failure on 512-token decode, error: "decoder linear weight shape mismatch for shard part_3". Suspect wrong shard offset ordering.

ryan: That usually means the filenames don't encode TP index and our loader assumes interleaved ordering. I pushed a tiny change to convert script to include a metadata file `tp_index_map.json` and a checksum header. PR: https://git.redwood/infr/convert/pull/78 (tiny). @maria can you re-run once merged?

maria: Re-running now against the PR head. ETA ~10m. I'm also provisioning a temporary fp16 fallback in Dedicated to run perf/regression side-by-side while the bf16 run completes.

ops-bot: Reminder: for Private deployments, artifacts in buckets must be encrypted and access via S3/priv-reg. Please ensure KMS is enabled for the new path. Ping @jamal for upload creds and ACLs.

jamal: I'll mirror artifacts to s3://redwood-private-onboard/nova-13b/conv-2026-02 and set bucket policy. Will also attach server-side encryption with KMS key `projects/redwood/kms/nova-onboard`.

sasha: Also add a unit test: eng-ml/packaging/test_tokenizer_offsets.py — assert that special token ids match our canonical mapping and that decode(encode(sample_prompt)) is stable.

maria: Good call. If this re-run passes checksum + kv dry-run, I'll open a canary rollout ticket and tag infra/sre. If it fails again I'll paste the exact shard headers and we can decide rename vs re-shard.

ryan: If you still hit the mismatch, a quick workaround is to re-index parts to `tp-{i}.safetensors` interleaved vs contiguous. I'll help script that if needed.

maria: logs: upload complete, running validation...

(10m later)

maria: Validation passed: checksum OK, kv-dry-run OK, tokenizer normalized. Starting canary rollout request now. :tada:

jamal: Mirrored to S3 and set KMS + ACLs. Notarized the checksum file and uploaded `tp_index_map.json`.

sasha: Adding the tokenizer unit test in a follow-up PR.

maria: Thanks everyone. Will monitor the canary and report regressions here. If anything pops, ping @ryan or @sasha for immediate unroll.
